Default data_as_elements converts span and div with data-as

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
